title: SAL protects endothelial cells from H(2)O(2)-induced endothelial dysfunction: Regulation of inflammation and autophagy by EZH2.
authors: Sun, Li; Li, Xuefang; Zhang, Jie; Pei, Jiachao; Zhang, Jianhua; Wang, Yinghua; Lin, Fei; Zhao, Guoan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红景天苷通过EZH2调控炎症与自噬保护内皮细胞，仅用分子对接辅助，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: One component of the polycomb repressor complex 2 is histone methyltransferase zeste homolog 2 (EZH2), which is also called Enhancer of zeste homolog 2. It is considered a potential therapeutic target for inhibiting endothelial dysfunction.. Hence, directing efforts towards EZH2 to weaken endothelium damage and regulate vascular lesions proves to be a highly successful therapeutic approach for enhancing endothelial dysfunction. This study aimed to investigate the mechanism by which salidroside (SAL) improves hydrogen peroxide (H(2)O(2))-induced endothelial dysfunction. The investigation involved the use of many techniques, including western blotting, real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), a scratch test, molecular docking, and other methods. The experimental findings demonstrated that SAL has the ability to inhibit the impaired functioning of endothelial cells caused by H(2)O(2) and decrease the levels of NF-kappaB p65, NLRP3, TNF-alpha, Beclin1, LC3, and P62 proteins. Additionally, there seems to be a targeting relationship between SAL and EZH2, and EZH2 knockdown can reproduce the protective effect of SAL on endothelial function. Overall, SAL inhibits H(2)O(2)-induced HUVEC dysfunction by regulating autophagy and inflammatory signaling pathways through EZH2.
abstract_zh: 多梳抑制复合物2的一个组分是组蛋白甲基转移酶zeste同源物2（EZH2），也称为zeste同源物增强子2。它被认为是抑制内皮功能障碍的潜在治疗靶点。因此，将努力方向对准EZH2以减轻内皮损伤并调节血管病变，被证明是改善内皮功能障碍的一种非常成功的治疗方法。本研究旨在探讨红景天苷（SAL）改善过氧化氢（H(2)O(2)）诱导的内皮功能障碍的机制。研究采用了多种技术，包括蛋白质印迹法、实时聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）、划痕实验、分子对接等方法。实验结果表明，SAL能够抑制H(2)O(2)引起的内皮细胞功能受损，并降低NF-kappaB p65、NLRP3、TNF-alpha、Beclin1、LC3和P62蛋白的水平。此外，SAL与EZH2之间似乎存在靶向关系，且EZH2敲低可以重现SAL对内皮功能的保护作用。总体而言，SAL通过EZH2调控自噬和炎症信号通路，从而抑制H(2)O(2)诱导的HUVEC功能障碍。
